concepts.title: 11  Offset Building Blocks
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create an original logo concept for "GentlePath", a warm, memorable family app for parents navigating autism. The user explicitly requests BUILDING BLOCKS carrying G and P, OFFSET and STACKED in the app's own colors.
Reference image role: the user's favorite proof layout, strong uppercase G/P letters, friendly substantial geometry and warm identity. Use the three-sample presentation and typography character as a reference. For this new experiment, the emblem is actual simple BUILDING BLOCKS.
Specific symbol: exactly TWO chunky softly rounded toy-building-block cubes stacked as a compact stair-step tower. The UPPER cube is shifted LEFT, the LOWER cube is shifted RIGHT by about one-third of a cube width. The upper cube visibly rests on the lower cube's upper-left portion, physically plausible and connected. Upper cube's front face is deep forest #174E46 with a big ivory uppercase "G". Lower cube's front face is pale lilac #ECE2F6 with a big deep-forest uppercase "P". Show an extremely shallow consistent three-quarter view: a tiny side face and top face use actual sage #E0ECD9 and sunlight #F8DC94 to communicate building blocks. Use crisp flat ink planes, only 2 or 3 faces per cube; this is a reduced vector brand mark, not a photorealistic toy render. No studs, letters on side faces, wood grain, gloss, shading, perspective distortion, extra cubes or extra symbols. The FRONT letters G and P must be large, unmistakable and upright. Both blocks need the same geometry and size. The entire stack is compact and balanced, not a tall narrow tower. Feel reassuring, warm and playful with adult-quality branding.
Presentation: high-resolution landscape 3:2 ivory #FFFDF8 board. At left, a generously sized rounded-square ivory app tile containing the block stack. At center, the identical standalone stack. At right, the identical small stack beside the exact wordmark "GentlePath" in warm bold humanist sans with excellent spacing. Right lockup occupies about half of the page, entire text fits, no cropping. SAME stack geometry and colors in all three formats. The tiny perspective is part of the actual logo drawing, not a scene mockup. Title at top left exactly "11  Offset Building Blocks". Labels underneath: "App Icon", "Symbol", "Icon + Text". No other copy.
Use only actual GentlePath colors: forest #174E46, ivory #FFFDF8, sage #E0ECD9, lilac #ECE2F6, sunlight #F8DC94. Prioritize forest and lilac, keep the other color faces small. Clean plain backgrounds, flat vector shapes, precise outlines, no textures, gradients, shadows, realistic 3D rendering, photography, cartoon mascots, trees, hearts, puzzle connections, watermarks or additional objects.
